meta.note: The game has no passive skill tree. It was cleared because the fundamentals were still moving: 82 of its 100 points bought rules that granted no numbers, so every point of DPS sat in 18 keystones and the tree was a keystone picker with connective tissue rather than a node graph. Kept as an empty shell so the mob_HP fold point and the cage survive for whatever replaces it. Nothing here grants power, and no document may quote a tree multiplier while this file is empty.
